data.one_liner: Time picker widget with a spinner interface supporting 12 or 24 hour format.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable spinner time picker widget that works with 12 or 24 hour formats, custom intervals, and seconds. It allows adjusting text styles, spacing, and item heights for the picker wheels.
use_when: You need a spinner-style time selection UI instead of the default material time picker dialog.
Your app requires custom time intervals or 12/24 hour format configuration.
avoid_when: You want to use the default platform material time picker.
You need date picking functionality as well as time.
strengths: Supports both 12 and 24 hour time formats.
Customizable text styles, item heights, and spacing for the spinner.
Supports custom minutes and seconds intervals.
weaknesses: No documentation for topics or advanced state validation out of the box.
